description: Same canonical input/output API; roots and all allocations included in operation_ms. Rotate order of four candidates. Kernel h<8 uses lane permutation in small, inverse roots use w^-j = -w^(h-j) in roots. Both applies both candidates. All files in /tmp. No public changes until measured.
memory_metric_status: Do not use max_rss_kib in this phase: direct fork from Python retained its large parent footprint. Authoritative memory is memory-final, which uses a small exec helper before forking the byte-identical executable.
